lynch_mrs.text: Sit, sit. If someone is 'gas' in Cork, they are funny. My husband is gas. My son is a langer, but a lovely one.
A Hushwing lives in the church roof round the corner. A barn owl can hear a mouse in the dark, so tiptoeing past will not fool it.
The Lee has salmon in it. They come back to the river they were born in, and they never ask for directions.
